claims.claim: The endpoint-controlled audit is technically valid.
claims.falsifier: Any lineage, endpoint, exposure, RNG, cache, or isolation mismatch.
claims.required_evidence: shared full-parent hash; reducer endpoint equivalence; equal event/example multisets; common block RNG; fresh-session isolation; token/step audit

claims.claim: A named update operator violates terminal consistency.
claims.falsifier: Upper CI below epsilon_JS or a contaminated execution.
claims.required_evidence: Item-paired endpoint-defect lower CI above epsilon_JS.

claims.claim: Violation structure exceeds generic sequential-update geometry.
claims.falsifier: No frozen held-out improvement beyond the complete baseline stack.
claims.required_evidence: Held-out incremental prediction beyond update-count, terminal-loss, gradient, optimizer-kernel, and Lie-bracket baselines.

claims.claim: The failure matters beyond synthetic reset-LoRA.
claims.falsifier: Failure is confined to nonce prompts, one lineage, or one toy operator.
claims.required_evidence: Different model lineage, realistic task, existing parametric updater, textual consolidator, and a task-native consequence.

claims.falsifier: A simple baseline closes the resource-matched deployment gap.
claims.required_evidence: Restore, refit, modular, and existing-editor baselines leave a gap.

claims.claim: A contract-aware repair improves the deployment frontier.
claims.falsifier: No resource-matched frontier improvement over simple baselines.
claims.required_evidence: Untouched-data improvement in consistency, accuracy, locality, compute, storage, and rollback latency.

non_claims: first path dependence in language-model updates
universal ranking of external versus parametric memory
